name: Hesitation
idea: Dribble fast, slow down like you're stopping, then speed up and blow past your defender.
why: When you slow down, your defender slows down too and stands up tall. That tiny rest is all you need: speed up while they're standing still, and they can't catch you.
tryit: Dribble fast, then take two slow bounces and lift your head like you're looking to pass. Then push the ball out in front and sprint. Fast, slow, fast!

frames.say: {1} is dribbling at the top, and {X1} is guarding.
{1} dribbles fast toward the basket, and {X1} backs up to stay in front.
*Hesitation:* {1} slows down and lifts their head, like they're stopping. {X1} slows down and stands up tall.
Then {1} speeds up and zooms right past. {X1} was standing still and can't catch up!
Layup! Fast, slow, fast. Changing speed beats your defender.
